    Put the calibration's passing sets first in a starting population

    withPassingFirst.Rd

    passing (runSpreadWithoutDEoptim()'s passingPars) are placed first and the rest of pop follows, cut to pop's number of rows (clusters::clusterSetup() uses the first NP). They were drawn between lower and upper, so one outside them is a changed bound or a bug and stops, rather than being clamped.

    withPassingFirst(passing, pop, lower, upper)

    Arguments

    passing

    matrix of parameter sets with the columns of lower, or NULL.

    pop

    the starting population, n rows (uniformSets() or feasibleInitialPopulation()).

    lower, upper

    the bounds, named.

    Value

    pop if passing is NULL; otherwise n rows with attribute feasible (as pop's, plus the passing sets, at most n) when pop has one.
